description.describe_ch: 本課程將透過觀察力與日常生活的體驗來發掘學生的創意來源。創業學將分為三個主軸；第一個主軸介紹創意的基礎觀念(創意是可以培養與學習)；第二個主軸以系統化的方式將創意的根源、過程、影響因子、及其結果做介紹；第三個主軸是應用創意聯想法解決商品市場化做一整合評估。
description.describe_eh: This course includes 3 major topics in fostering student's ability to create. The first topic introduces the basic concept of creativity (which can be fostered and learned). The next topic is about applying a systemic way of learning the sources, processes, factors, and results of creativity. The last topic not only discusses but also assesses the whole process from an idea creation to a real marketable product.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Behavior in the classroom should always be prompt, professional, prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only be achieved by maintaining mutual dignity and mutual respect among classmates and teachers. In order to ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is expected to do the following, abide by each other's classroom behavior rules, and get used to a culture of politeness.
1.	Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
2.	All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
3.	Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. 
4.	You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loudly to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
5.	Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
6.	Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile phones are turned off during class, and put away and keep silent.
7.	Students are not allowed to wear earphones in class.
Thank you for your cooperation!
課堂行為
課堂上的行為始終應要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師或其他講師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為了確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂行為規則，習慣禮貌的文化。
學生應準時出席上課。如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。 除非您生病或有緊急情況，否則應在上課前，要準時到達教室，並坐在位子上。如果您有某種原因必須提早下課，請提前告知我。
所有學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以合理、負責和禮貌的態度行事。
上課時請勿講話、閱讀、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除分組進行討論外，否則應盡量減少邊際對話。如果您正坐在一個可能在上課時和您聊天的人旁邊，請移到另一個座位，以免您屈服於誘惑。
當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。當您簡報時，您應該面對自己的小組或全班同學大聲說話，讓同學能聽清楚。
允許使用筆記型電腦或平板等載具，進行課堂記筆記，否則應將其收起。
要確保在上課時，關閉手機、PDA等移動設備，並收起及保持靜音。
不得戴耳機上課。
學生責任
每學期註冊開學前，到MyFCU個人資料表，確認自己在逢甲大學所留的基本資料。包含手機電話、電子郵件、通訊住址等聯絡資訊，以利授課教師、教學助理、或開課單位職員能與您聯繫。
確認您的逢甲大學o365電子郵件和NID密碼是開通的。此將是對於身份驗證和電子資源使用是必需的，如網路教室、圖書館資源、軟體資源、門禁、線上課程、個人學習歷程、MyFCU App等資源。
您要詳讀及了解本課程的教學大綱要求，即時更新最新資訊，做好學習時間的管理。
隨時檢查您的逢甲大學電子郵件和登錄iLearn 清楚本課程所發布之訊息。
恪守誠信，應該保持高度的專業素養，積極出席和參與本課堂的學習承諾，以及在課堂內外行為皆是正直。
使用圖書館館藏、有版權的教材讀本。
您應依授課進度與內容所列之週次及節次，對本科目填寫期中、期末之課程教學回饋意見。您的參與及回饋，將幫助我改善上課技巧、課程教學內容及活動的安排，也提供開課單位的教學品質至關重要的意見。期中形成性教學評估表在第4~8週填寫；期末學生意見調查、期末課程目標學習達成情形在學期最後一個月填寫。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Classroom Behavior Policy
Behavior in the classroom should always be prompt, professional, well-prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only occur when both students and instructors uphold mutual dignity and respect.
To ensure a productive learning environment, each student is expected to follow the guidelines below, abide by classroom conduct rules, and foster a culture of politeness.

Students must arrive on time. If your schedule does not allow punctual attendance, you should not register for the class. Unless you are sick or have an emergency, you are expected to be in the classroom and seated before the class begins. If you need to leave early, please inform the instructor in advance.

All students must treat others with respect and always act in a reasonable, responsible, and courteous manner.

Do not talk, read, sleep, or work on unrelated assignments during class. Except during group discussions, side conversations should be minimized. If you are seated near someone likely to engage in off-topic conversation, please move to another seat to avoid distraction.

When classmates are presenting or asking questions, you should listen attentively. When it is your turn to present, speak clearly and loudly to your group or the class so everyone can hear you.

Laptops and tablets are allowed for note-taking; otherwise, they should be put away.

Ensure all mobile devices (e.g., phones, PDAs) are turned off or set to silent mode and stored away during class.

Wearing earphones during class is not allowed.
Thank you for your cooperation!

Student Responsibilities

Before the semester begins, check and confirm your personal contact information on the MyFCU system (e.g., mobile number, email address, mailing address) so that instructors, teaching assistants, or administrative staff can contact you if necessary.

Ensure your Feng Chia University O365 email and NID password are activated. These credentials are required for accessing online classrooms, library resources, software services, building access, online courses, learning records, the MyFCU App, and more.

Carefully read and understand the course syllabus and keep updated on any changes. Manage your study time effectively.

Regularly check your FCU email and iLearn platform for announcements and course-related messages.

Uphold academic integrity and maintain a high level of professionalism. Actively participate in class and demonstrate honesty and responsibility both inside and outside the classroom.

Use library collections and licensed materials for your coursework.

Follow the course schedule and provide midterm and final feedback through the designated teaching evaluation forms. Your input is crucial for improving instructional methods, course content, and classroom activities. The formative midterm teaching evaluation is open from Weeks 4 to 8; the final student opinion survey and assessment of learning outcomes take place during the last month of the semester.

integrity.course_pol_en:
Classroom Behavior Policy
Behavior in the classroom should always be prompt, professional, well-prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only occur when both students and instructors uphold mutual dignity and respect.
To ensure a productive learning environment, each student is expected to follow the guidelines below, abide by classroom conduct rules, and foster a culture of politeness.

Students must arrive on time. If your schedule does not allow punctual attendance, you should not register for the class. Unless you are sick or have an emergency, you are expected to be in the classroom and seated before the class begins. If you need to leave early, please inform the instructor in advance.

All students must treat others with respect and always act in a reasonable, responsible, and courteous manner.

Do not talk, read, sleep, or work on unrelated assignments during class. Except during group discussions, side conversations should be minimized. If you are seated near someone likely to engage in off-topic conversation, please move to another seat to avoid distraction.

When classmates are presenting or asking questions, you should listen attentively. When it is your turn to present, speak clearly and loudly to your group or the class so everyone can hear you.

Laptops and tablets are allowed for note-taking; otherwise, they should be put away.

Ensure all mobile devices (e.g., phones, PDAs) are turned off or set to silent mode and stored away during class.

Wearing earphones during class is not allowed.
Thank you for your cooperation!

Student Responsibilities

Before the semester begins, check and confirm your personal contact information on the MyFCU system (e.g., mobile number, email address, mailing address) so that instructors, teaching assistants, or administrative staff can contact you if necessary.

Ensure your Feng Chia University O365 email and NID password are activated. These credentials are required for accessing online classrooms, library resources, software services, building access, online courses, learning records, the MyFCU App, and more.

Carefully read and understand the course syllabus and keep updated on any changes. Manage your study time effectively.

Regularly check your FCU email and iLearn platform for announcements and course-related messages.

Uphold academic integrity and maintain a high level of professionalism. Actively participate in class and demonstrate honesty and responsibility both inside and outside the classroom.

Use library collections and licensed materials for your coursework.

Follow the course schedule and provide midterm and final feedback through the designated teaching evaluation forms. Your input is crucial for improving instructional methods, course content, and classroom activities. The formative midterm teaching evaluation is open from Weeks 4 to 8; the final student opinion survey and assessment of learning outcomes take place during the last month of the semester.
